question: Report Table 12 says its checkpoint was 'trained once at N=21'. The model now sitting in zeroshot_B1_neo_hookean/ is trained JOINTLY at N=21 and 33. Which one produced Table 12?

metrics_history_json_is_from_a_JOINT_run.summary: 36 entries, best combined_val_error 0.06575 at epoch 650 (65,000 steps), ended epoch 900 (90,000 steps)
metrics_history_json_is_from_a_JOINT_run.conclusion: per_resolution_val_error carries BOTH 21 and 33, so this history is unambiguously the joint trainer's.

zeroshot_eval_report_json_is_from_an OLD.contrast: B1 x Mooney-Rivlin and B1 x Arruda-Boyce both list SEVEN resolutions (13, 17, 25, 29, 37, 41, 49) and both carry a checkpoint_fingerprint.
zeroshot_eval_report_json_is_from_an OLD.conclusion: this eval report predates the fingerprint field and the 7-resolution list, i.e. it is older than the other two.

evidence.it_is_the_source_of_Table_12: PROJECT_STATUS records Table 12's source as this exact file with 15 values verified, and the five numbers match the report exactly (0.0574, 0.0521, 0.0525, 0.0562, 0.0670).

Later the case was retrained jointly at 21+33 as part of the six-case sweep, but its eval was never re-run, so metrics_history.json is new while the eval report is old.

implication_if_true: Table 12 and its caption stand as written
model_best.pt in that directory is NO LONGER the model Table 12 describes -- anything re-run against it will not reproduce Table 12

a joint-trained B1 x NH model ALREADY EXISTS (best val 0.06575) and needs only its EVAL re-run on the 7 resolutions to join B1 x MR and B1 x AB under one protocol. No retraining, no FEM generation -- the cheapest of the three remaining pieces of work

the_check_that_settles_it.what: run_manifest.json in zeroshot_B1_neo_hookean/ records every stage with a timestamp and its argv.
the_check_that_settles_it.look_for: a zeroshot_train entry whose --train_resolutions is '21,33'. Compare its finished_at_utc against the zeroshot_eval entry's. If the joint TRAIN finished AFTER the EVAL, reading A holds. If the only train entry is joint and precedes the eval, reading B holds.
the_check_that_settles_it.command: import json; [print(e['kind'], e['finished_at_utc'], e['args'].get('train_resolutions')) for e in json.load(open('/content/drive/MyDrive/pfem_run/zeroshot_B1_neo_hookean/run_manifest.json'))]

why_this_matters_beyond_a_caption: under reading A the remaining work for a uniform three-case B1 table is one eval run, not a retrain. Under reading B it is already done and only the report text is wrong. Either way it is cheap -- but the report currently makes a claim about how a model was trained, and that claim is either right or it is not.
